inference_seed_floor.definition: F = max(|point delta|, 95% half-width) of clip(seed 1) - clip(seed 0), ADE 6 s, all sealed windows

nav_feed.token_source: v9 per-frame nav_token via ds.r8_join.item (refc_v3_train.py:4657-4668, refcv8_train.py:895-898)
nav_feed.args_rule: r8_nav = refcv8_train.scale_nav(item r8_nav_raw, item r8_nav_known) on the nav_true row; unknown (known=0) -> exactly zeros; shuffled / flipped rows carry the unknown row; nav-zero call carries none
nav_feed.other_conditions: nav_shuffled / nav_flipped are derived from the SAME per-frame nav_true vector
